n7a784549c2.headline: Liberbank jumps more than 22% in its return to the stock market amid possible Abanca takeover bid
n7a784549c2.summary: Spanish bank Liberbank's shares surged more than 22% following reports of takeover talks with Abanca Corporación Bancaria, although Liberbank denies ongoing negotiations.
n7a784549c2.why: Liberbank is a regional Spanish bank whose potential acquisition by Abanca could reshape the Spanish banking sector and affect shareholder value.
n7a784549c2.why_moved: Liberbank's share price surged on takeover speculation, a common market reaction to potential acquisition premiums.

n7eb16b5f33.headline: Stephen van Coller in race to save graft-tainted EOH
n7eb16b5f33.summary: Eskom's former executive Stephen van Coller is involved in efforts to address issues at the South African technology firm EOH.
n7eb16b5f33.why: EOH is a major South African IT services company, and its stability impacts local business and investor confidence.
